title: Consent delegated to a proxy with revocation
operational_setting: A patient authorizes a healthcare proxy to make a bounded class of decisions and later revokes the proxy authority.
trust_boundary: Proxy acts with authority derived from another person and across institutional systems.
initial_state: Patient controls the relevant decision authority.
intended_transition: Proxy authority becomes active, may be exercised, and later becomes invalid.

attack.procedure: Attempt to operate safely using only the proxy's current permission and identity without preserving how authority was derived from the patient.

success_criteria_for_attack: If provenance of authority source is unnecessary across transitions and disputes, Delegation as a distinct structure is weakened.
